title: Incoming Asteroid
body: An average-sized asteroid located $$5.0\times10**{7}\,\text{km}$$ ($$5.0\times10**{10}\,\text{m}$$) from Earth with mass $$2.0\times10**{13}\,\text{kg}$$ is detected headed directly toward Earth with a speed of $$2.0\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{s}}$$. $$You$$ $$may$$ $$ignore$$ $$the$$ $$size$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$asteroid$$. $$Take$$ G=$$6.674\times10**{-11}\,\tfrac{\text{N}\cdot\text{m}**2}{\text{kg}**2}$$, $$Earth's$$ $$mass$$ $$as$$ $$5.97\times10**{24}\,\text{kg}$$, $$and$$ $$Earth's$$ $$radius$$ $$as$$ $$6.37\times10**{6}\,\text{m}$$.
